できれば横向きでお願いします。

Draw the front side of her body. Draw her entire body. Draw her standing in water. The background should be tropical, like she is at the beach of アリマゴ島. Please make sure the bottom of the bikini is visible and is not covered by anything like a skirt or sarong.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1H5N4Gi5A17simvHrskvm33qRbKDXFPzD?usp=sharing
